capabilities._note: Video to sound: Tencent's HunyuanVideo-Foley, the XL model, through phazei's ComfyUI-HunyuanVideo-Foley. Measured 2026-11-01 (docs/SOUND.md 'Models', Foley): it hit the marks, a close second to the LTX-2.3 Foley LoRA by ear; 68-125 s a shot (50 steps). Tencent's HunyuanVideo-Foley community licence: it doesn't apply in some territories (read it) and claims no rights in the outputs. SigLIP2 and CLAP are read from the Hugging Face cache (`fetches`: downloaded in Features, never by the pack).

binding._note: The take goes up as a file (LoadVideo, its frames by GetVideoComponents), made 512 wide at its own frame rate by fx.stage first. HunyuanModelLoader (bf16, quantization auto), HunyuanDependenciesLoader (the DAC VAE and synchformer), HunyuanFoleySampler at 50 steps, cfg 4.5, euler, the take's frame rate and seconds, SaveAudio. Validated on local ComfyUI 0.43, 2026-11-01.

presets._note: The pack's suggested settings (its README: euler, cfg about 4.5, about 50 steps), as measured; the picture 512 wide, its height kept to its shape (0), at its own frame rate.

final.negative: music, speech, talking, voices, singing, noisy, harsh

fetches._note: ComfyUI-HunyuanVideo-Foley's HunyuanDependenciesLoader loads SigLIP2 and CLAP with transformers' from_pretrained: from the Hugging Face cache when they're there, else downloaded then and there. The Features window downloads them instead, and the target isn't ready without them (seriesmith/hubcache.py). The files are what from_pretrained reads: SigLIP2's model (its pictures are prepared by torchvision, not its processor), CLAP's tokenizer and text model.

downloads._note: The converted safetensors ComfyUI-HunyuanVideo-Foley's README points to (huggingface.co/phazei/HunyuanVideo-Foley, listed 2026-11-01). Its node pack is https://github.com/phazei/ComfyUI-HunyuanVideo-Foley (features.PACKS).
